Saber Sneakers are available for $86. They come in various colors including Serene, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Khaki, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue. Sizes available range from 41 to 48. The brand '7SABER' was officially launched on June 25, 2021, in collaboration with the London Institute of Identity and the Tashkent agency GRANDPR.
